title: What If One Person Delivered Every Amazon Package?
description:
What if one person had to deliver every fast Amazon package in a day?

Sources:
- Amazon: over 9 billion items delivered same day or next day worldwide in 2024 (PYMNTS, reporting Amazon's announcement): https://www.pymnts.com/?p=2438049
- Amazon 2023 delivery speeds (About Amazon): https://www.aboutamazon.com/md/news/operations/doug-herrington-amazon-prime-delivery-speed-2024-updates

Per-day and per-second figures are 9 billion divided by 365 days and 86,400 seconds. Not financial advice.

#shorts #amazon #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time a package shows up, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: What if one person had to deliver every fast Amazon package in a single day?
In 2024, Amazon said more than 9 billion items arrived the same day or the next day.
That's about 25 million packages every single day.
Our one driver would need to drop off nearly 300 packages every second. No breaks. No sleep.
Instead, Amazon spreads that load across a huge network of warehouses, vans and drivers. That speed is what keeps Prime members paying.
